concept: A Franco-Moroccan patisserie; shop, pre-order and cafe.

shots.title: Hero, the room
shots.prompt: Restaurant interior photograph of a patisserie with marble counters and glass domes in Jumeirah during evening service, tables set, warm practical lighting, atmospheric and inviting, nobody in focus.
